name: Long Walk climb
desc: Main Building to the top of the Long Walk, on the trails.

name: Sheridan sprint
desc: Campus to downtown Sheridan on the roads.

name: Willamina run
desc: Campus to downtown Willamina on the roads.

name: Hwy 18 top speed
desc: Flat out up the long straight of Hwy 18 toward McMinnville. No ramps, no excuses.

name: McMinnville downtown sprint
desc: West down NE 3rd St through downtown McMinnville, then round the blocks to the north.

name: Sheridan river loop
desc: South over Sheridan Bridge, east through town, back across the South Yamhill on Hwy 18 and home along the river.

name: South woods loop
desc: Round the trail loop south of campus.

name: North woods scramble
desc: Campus up through the north trails to the far ridge.

name: Gravel run
desc: Campus out along the gravel roads to the northeast fields.

name: Odyssey
desc: The whole Odyssey trail loop round the south woods, clockwise.

name: Ripp's Ravine
desc: Down Ripp's trail into the ravine, up the Agony and round the west woods back to the top.

name: Hwy 18 sortie
desc: Take off on Hwy 18 and race the rings southwest over Sheridan to campus.

name: Valley loop
desc: Off the long road east of campus, a big loop round the valley past Willamina.

name: Yamhill valley rings
desc: Take off up Hwy 18, then a big ring course over the valley: the river bends, Whiteson, Amity and down to Bellevue.
